proposed.rationale: SPP Document 202, Section 5.2 gives only the total multiplier range of 1.5-2.5, with qualitative factors (office setup, overhead, the Architect's experience, project complexity). It does not decompose the multiplier into an overhead sub-range of 1.4-1.7 or any other fixed sub-components; such decompositions are exam traps. Source: SPP 202 Sec 5.2 (https://www.architectureboard.com.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/1.4-2010-SPP-for-PH-Architects.pdf).
proposed.explanation: SPP 202 Sec 5.2 supports only the total 1.5-2.5 multiplier range. Any overhead/profit/non-technical sub-range decomposition is invented, not source-backed.
